_exclude_types: Scholar item types left off the site (journal, conference, preprint, patent)
_pi_aliases: Ways the PI's name appears in Google Scholar / patent author strings
_main_author_members: Lab members marked * (first/main author) on every paper they appear in
_former_members: Alumni whose papers should still be marked as lab first/corresponding author. Current members are read from assets/js/data.js automatically.

kipris._note: Korean patents. Set the KIPRIS_API_KEY environment variable (or GitHub secret) to enable.
